newsitem.title: USA: Blue-chip stocks romp to new highs.
newsitem.headline: Blue-chip stocks romp to new highs.

text.p: Blue-chip stocks ended in record territory Friday as the continued decline of long-term interest rates kept Wall Street in a bullish mode.

Based on early and unofficial data, the Dow Jones industrial average ended up 19.45 points at 7,796.51, surpassing last Friday's record finish of 7,782.04. The Standard & Poor's 500 index also set a new high.

The "triple witching" expiration of options and futures made for a very volatile session, and in the broader market, declining issues led advances on active volume of 656 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
